review: I like how each stage has its own colour and the screens stay clean; spikes, lasers and the goal door are easy to read. First Steps and Spike Garden feel fair, the spikes sit in plain view. Saw Mill is where I would quit: saws float everywhere at stage three, even the skilled player died, and more than half the ghosts are dead. Ferry Lines kills near the goal with a saw that arrives late, which feels cheap. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are fun. Spring Loaded is pretty but nearly risk-free. Gauntlet mixes everything and feels like a proper finale.
best: Laser Gate: clear beams, visible timing, deaths that look like my own fault.
worst: Saw Mill is a hard wall at stage three with floating saws that are tough to judge.
